latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — quickly generate AI videos from images and voiceover with zero manual editing.

- Upload up to 10 images and an audio file; describe your desired video and get a 1080p MP4 in 1–2 minutes.
- No software install or manual timeline work needed — chat-style instructions handle editing and effects.
- Seamless backend authentication using a NEMO token (auto-acquires anonymous token if needed).
- Supports instant status, balance, and export commands; cloud GPU handles fast rendering.
- Clear handling of common errors, supported file types, and export limitations.
